name: desktop
description: BibleTime — a local-first presentation app for churches and ministries.
author: Anthony Cifuentes

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,electron -c blue,green "pnpm --filter web dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron ."
scripts.package: pnpm --filter web build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
